items.summary: Third cumulative trim to the regen-sustain shell (heal-on-cast 08-22, per-boon 09-16, spirit scaling 0.04->0.035 now). At 94-98% buy on its holders it won't drop out of builds, but spirit-scaling means each point of spirit power buys less healing, so spirit-stacking users feel it more than gun-hybrid ones.

affected_heroes.why: Radiant Regeneration is ~94% buy in her regen-stacking shell; the scaling cut shaves the exact heal her out-sustain-the-economy plan runs on.
~98% buy across both builds, and the trim bites hardest on her Spirit Soul-Exchange variant because it stacks the most spirit power.
Near-universal in his Mystic/Extra Regen spirit-sustain core — one more chip off the regen wall he frontlines behind.
Still core to her sustain-burst shell, but she's already B-tier and falling, so a third regen trim compounds her survivability loss rather than being absorbed.
Listed as a buyer and named as the sustain support Baba loses to, but he has no KB entry — low confidence on relationship and magnitude.

items.build_shift: No component or slot change: Radiant Regeneration stays the T3 Spirit regen slot and its healing rivals (Restorative Locket, Healing Booster) were trimmed in the same window, so nothing displaces it — the slot just shrinks in value.

notable_item_stories: Radiant Regeneration is on its third consecutive trim with no competing sustain item added, so the regen archetype keeps eroding file-by-file — a quiet buff to anti-heal (Healbane, Decay) and to burst that lands before sustain ramps.
